stocks.name: CoreWeave
stocks.headline: A beat that lifted AI stocks
stocks.body: Third-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion topped CoreWeave's own forecast. It raised its 2026 sales outlook to $13.0–$13.3 billion, and AI stocks rallied with it.

stocks.name: Micron Technology
stocks.headline: Memory chips ride along
stocks.body: Memory makers led the chip rally after CoreWeave's results eased worries about AI spending. Micron is still about 35% below its June high.

stocks.name: Oracle
stocks.headline: AI cloud stocks bounce
stocks.body: Oracle climbed as CoreWeave's results lifted the whole AI cloud group. It had fallen about 18% since its October 28 investor day.

stocks.name: Corning
stocks.headline: A new Buy from Jefferies
stocks.body: Jefferies started covering Corning with a Buy rating and a $134 price target. It expects AI data centers to keep demand for Corning's fiber high.

stocks.name: Grocery Outlet
stocks.headline: A trimmed profit forecast
stocks.body: Sales rose just 0.9% to $1.18 billion. Grocery Outlet also cut the top of its 2026 forecast for adjusted EBITDA, a measure of profit, to $229 million.

stocks.name: Fossil Group
stocks.headline: The turnaround keeps ticking
stocks.body: Fossil swung to an $11.7 million profit and raised its 2026 sales forecast to $980–$990 million. It also extended its Diesel watch license by five years.

stocks.name: Boyd Group Services
stocks.headline: Sales up 28%, profit missed
stocks.body: The owner of Gerber Collision grew sales 28% to over $1 billion, helped by acquisitions. Adjusted profit of 68 cents a share missed the 85 cents expected.

stocks.name: Riskified
stocks.headline: Its first $100M quarter
stocks.body: Revenue jumped 41% to $115.2 million, the fraud-prevention firm's first quarter above $100 million. It raised its 2026 sales forecast to $427–$433 million.

stocks.name: Azenta
stocks.headline: 28 cents vs 11 expected
stocks.body: Azenta's adjusted profit of 28 cents a share beat the 11 cents analysts expected, on $167 million in sales. Its fiscal 2027 sales forecast also topped estimates.

stocks.name: BrightView
stocks.headline: Fewer new projects
stocks.body: BrightView's revenue fell 3.6% to $677.3 million as revenue from new landscape projects dropped 18%. The stock hit a 52-week low.
